_comment: Template for the Smobilpay smoke-test harness. Copy to smoke-test.json and fill in baseUrl, publicKey, secretKey from your partner credentials, then populate each per-flow block with serviceIds and test data valid for your environment. Set a block to null (or remove it) to skip that scenario. Spec terminology: cashout = collection (money OUT of customer wallet), cashin = disbursement (money INTO recipient wallet).

cashout._comment: Collection — money flows OUT of customer wallet. Set serviceId to a CASHOUT-type service from your catalog (see services() output) and amount to a valid integer in the service's local currency.

bill._comment: SEARCHABLE_BILL or NON_SEARCHABLE_BILL. Set merchant + serviceId to a bill-type service from your catalog and serviceNumber to a known-good test contract/meter number issued by the merchant.

topup._comment: TOPUP airtime. Set serviceId to a TOPUP-type service from your catalog and amount to a valid integer denomination.

_voucher_comment: VOUCHER-type service. After running once, find a VOUCHER service in the smoke-test's 'Service catalog' output (line: '- VOUCHER: N') by inspecting client.masterdata().services() entries with type=VOUCHER, then replace the null above with { "serviceId": <that id> }.

product._comment: PRODUCT. Set serviceId to a PRODUCT-type service from your catalog.

subscription._comment: SUBSCRIPTION. Set merchant + serviceId to a SUBSCRIPTION-type service from your catalog and supply either serviceNumber or customerNumber (one only — leave the other null).

cashin._comment: Disbursement — money flows INTO recipient wallet. Set serviceId to a CASHIN-type service from your catalog. Set 'collect' to true (with customerPhonenumber, customerEmailaddress, serviceNumber populated) to follow the quote with a real POST /v2/collectstd — this MOVES MONEY on the configured environment. Omit 'collect' or set it to false to stay quote-only.

verify._comment: Pre-payment serviceNumber validation — only services with isVerifiable=true support this. Set merchant + serviceId to a verifiable service from your catalog and serviceNumber to a known-good account.

validate._comment: Account validation via GET /v2/validate — returns a CustomerAccount {status, name, destination}. Status: UNKNOWN | VALIDATED (syntax only) | VERIFIED (cross-checked with provider). Set destination to the wallet identifier (MSISDN/account number) to validate and serviceId to the service that should perform the lookup.
